options.label: Write the expected behaviour before the code
options.description: In 3-5 bullet points, describe what the feature does from the user's perspective — inputs, outputs, and edge cases. Write this before the implementation, not after.

options.label: Define what done looks like for this feature
options.description: Complete this sentence: 'This feature is done when...'. Make it specific enough that you could verify it with a single test. Vague done criteria compound into scope creep.

options.label: Write the acceptance criteria for the current task
options.description: List the conditions under which you'd accept a PR for this feature. If you were reviewing someone else's implementation, what would you check? Write those criteria now.
